clue.text: Live donkeys and squirrels

explanation.surface: A farmyard scene with living donkeys alongside squirrels.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Squirrels' looks like a noun in a list of animals, but it is the verb: to squirrel away is to hoard.
explanation.definitionFit: To squirrel things away is to hoard or stockpile them, gathering a store together.

clue.text: Some quondam Boanerges's stand

indicators.note: only some of the following letters are wanted, a run taken from inside the words

parts.note: spans the end of quondam and the start of Boanerges

explanation.surface: The former platform of a fiery preacher, Boanerges being a name for a loud orator.
explanation.definitionFit: An ambo is a raised stand or pulpit in early churches from which scripture was read.

clue.text: Pilot finds a sex appliance after clearing out bedroom

indicators.note: clearing something out of a word removes those letters from it

parts.note: a sex toy

explanation.surface: A pilot turns up an embarrassing toy while emptying out a bedroom.
explanation.walkthrough: Bedroom looks like the room being cleared, but its abbreviation is what gets cleared out of the appliance.
explanation.definitionFit: An aviator is a person who flies an aircraft, an old-fashioned word for a pilot.

clue.text: European minister rudely interrupted by European president

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for European
taken as written
a second E for European

explanation.surface: A European cabinet minister is rudely cut off mid-speech by a European head of state.
explanation.walkthrough: Both uses of European are wordplay, so the definition is just president. Frank-Walter Steinmeier is the President of Germany.
explanation.definitionFit: Frank-Walter Steinmeier became Germany's head of state in 2017, the federal president in Berlin.

clue.text: UK charity in need of square deal

parts.note: S taken as a shortening of square, as in sq
to deal with something is to cope

explanation.surface: A British charity is short of a fair settlement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Square deal' reads as one phrase meaning a fair bargain but splits into two pieces. Scope is a UK disability charity.
explanation.definitionFit: Scope is a national British charity supporting disabled people and their families.

clue.text: Someone from Africa united Gabon with Angola

parts.note: U is the abbreviation for united, as in football club names

AN taken as a short form of Angola

explanation.surface: A news line about two African nations, Gabon and Angola, joining together.
explanation.walkthrough: Gabon and Angola look like part of the African definition but are only letter sources.
explanation.definitionFit: A Ugandan is a native or citizen of Uganda, a country in East Africa.

clue.text: Virgin sees sense in nude dancing

touch is one of the five senses

explanation.definitionFit: Virgin as an adjective means pristine, not yet handled or spoilt, as in virgin snow.

clue.text: Old war correspondent has exposed women

indicators.note: exposing a word strips off its outer covering, its first and last letters

parts.note: ladies are women

explanation.surface: A veteran war reporter has photographed women undressed.
explanation.walkthrough: Kate Adie is a BBC reporter famed for covering wars in the 1980s and 1990s.
explanation.definitionFit: Kate Adie was the BBC's chief news correspondent, reporting from many war zones, now retired.

clue.text: Canvas had to be put over Mexican bloomers

parts.note: a sail is made of canvas
taken as written

explanation.surface: Mexican knickers made from canvas, a comic picture of rough underwear.
explanation.walkthrough: Bloomers looks like underwear but means flowers; dahlias originate in Mexico.
explanation.definitionFit: Dahlias are flowering plants native to Mexico, its national flower, so they are Mexican flowers.

clue.text: Sad aliens, sadly, talked through their noses

indicators.note: something done sadly goes badly wrong, so these letters end up in the wrong order

parts.note: the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: Unhappy visitors from space whined in nasal voices.
explanation.definitionFit: Nasalised speech sounds are made with air passing through the nose, the way people talk with a cold.

clue.text: French banker with billions in US capital

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for billion
a banker is something with banks, a river; the Oise is a river in France

explanation.walkthrough: 'Banker' suggests finance, but here it means a river, which has banks.
explanation.definitionFit: Boise is the state capital of Idaho, one of the fifty American state capitals.

clue.text: Some birds love to get instruction in developing chests

parts.note: taken as written, before it is rearranged
RI is religious instruction, a school subject

explanation.surface: Some birds love to be shown how to build up their chests, like a gym class.
explanation.definitionFit: Ostriches are large flightless African birds, so they are an example of some birds.

clue.text: Drunk is ready to drive off

definitions.meaning: first meaning: slang for intoxicated after heavy drinking
second meaning: with a full fuel tank

explanation.surface: A warning about a drunk getting behind the wheel.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pairs drink with driving; the two halves are separate meanings, one boozy and one about fuel.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to have drunk heavily and to have filled a vehicle's fuel tank before setting out.

clue.text: Joe has both hands on her

parts.note: a GI Joe is an American soldier
right and left, the two hands, abbreviated R and L

explanation.walkthrough: Joe looks like a name, but GI Joe is slang for an American soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl is a female person, the kind of person referred to by the feminine pronoun her.

clue.text: Still unable to poo?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: not moving at all
second meaning: lacking a bowel movement, which doctors call a motion

explanation.walkthrough: The second half splits the word in two: a motion is a bowel movement, and being without one is constipation.
explanation.definitionFit: Being still means not moving, and the second reading treats a medical motion as something one is without.

clue.text: Match design of white gear

indicators.note: a design is something made up or arranged, so the letters are laid out anew

parts.note: the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: Coordinate the look of some white clothing, perhaps cricket whites.
explanation.definitionFit: To match something is to correspond to it or be consistent with it, as figures can tally.

clue.text: Chairman's failed theory regarding workers' co-op groups

indicators.note: something failed has broken down, so these letters are wrecked and rebuilt

parts.note: the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A political chairman's flawed theory about workers' cooperatives, perhaps Chairman Mao's.
explanation.definitionFit: Anarchism, especially anarcho-syndicalism, holds that society should be run by voluntary cooperative groups of workers without a state.

clue.text: Cast a shadow over one dead traitor on ecstasy

parts.note: Roman numeral one
dead as in a limb without feeling
a rat is a betrayer
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A dead traitor on drugs casts a shadow over events.
explanation.definitionFit: To inumbrate is a rare literary verb meaning to shade, from the Latin word umbra, a shadow.

clue.text: Woman swims regularly in pool

parts.note: the second, fourth, sixth, eighth and tenth letters

explanation.surface: A woman does her regular swim in a pool.

explanation.definitionFit: An oasis is a fertile spot in a desert around a spring or pool of water.

clue.text: Part of single comment to the audience

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the main side of a vinyl record release
second meaning: a remark in a play heard by spectators but not other characters

explanation.surface: A singer's spoken interlude to the crowd during part of a record.
explanation.definitionFit: A seven-inch record had an A-side and a B-side, and a stage aside is a remark the other actors pretend not to hear.

clue.text: Crane nested in Greenwich abode

indicators.note: a thing nested in something sits tucked inside it

parts.note: spans the end of Greenwich and most of abode

explanation.surface: A crane, the bird, has built its nest in a house in Greenwich, a London borough.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crane' and 'nested' suggest a bird, but this is Ichabod Crane, the schoolmaster in Washington Irving's The Legend of Sleepy Hollow.
explanation.definitionFit: Ichabod is the first name of Ichabod Crane in Washington Irving's story of the Headless Horseman.

clue.text: A Parisian died to save earth, though no longer worshipped

indicators.note: to save something is to keep it held safe inside

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: Undeified describes something stripped of godlike status, so it is no longer treated as divine or revered.

clue.text: Japanese art form for which furniture store holds a lot of store

explanation.walkthrough: My looks like a possessive, but it is an exclamation of surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: The coho is a Pacific species of salmon, also called the silver salmon.

clue.text: A US singer initially opted to go for a state of temporary inactivity

explanation.walkthrough: Inside the singer's name, the A replaces the letter that opted begins with.
explanation.definitionFit: Something in abeyance is suspended or on hold, temporarily set aside rather than ended.

clue.text: The old lady oddly admits: "I give up"

taken as written

clue.text: Down the tube

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

taken as written
